[00:00.30]Amazing grace, how sweet the sound
[00:11.00]That saved a wretch like me
[00:23.00]I once was lost but now I'm found
[00:34.00]Was blind, but now, I see
[00:45.00]T'was grace that taught
[00:50.00]My heart to fear
[00:56.00]And grace, my fears relieved
[01:07.00]How precious did that grace appear
[01:18.00]The hour I first believed
[01:30.00]Through many dangers, toils and snares
[01:40.00]We have already come
[01:52.00]T'was grace that brought us safe thus far
[02:02.00]And grace will lead us home
[02:14.00]When we've been there ten thousand years bright shining as the sun
[02:38.00]We've no less days to sing god's praise than when we first begun
